parsed.name: Feasibility & Constraints
parsed.condition: Execute when there are integration constraints, regulatory requirements, or significant technical uncertainty. Skip for trivial changes with no technical risk.
parsed.inputs: Intent statement from intent-capture stage, market research from market-research stage (if executed)
parsed.outputs: feasibility-assessment.md, constraint-register.md, raid-log.md, feasibility-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

parsed.name: Intent Capture & Framing
parsed.condition: First stage of every workflow — establishes the initiative's foundation
parsed.inputs: Authoritative project description (project-description utility), scope selection
parsed.outputs: intent-statement.md, stakeholder-map.md, intent-capture-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

parsed.condition: Execute when initiative has external market positioning or build-vs-buy considerations. Skip for internal tools, bug fixes, or refactors.
parsed.outputs: competitive-analysis.md, market-trends.md, build-vs-buy.md, market-research-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

parsed.condition: Execute when user-facing UI is part of the initiative; for API/backend, produce system interaction diagrams. Skip for non-UI, API-only, or infrastructure-only initiatives.
parsed.inputs: Intent statement, scope definition, intent backlog

parsed.condition: Always executes — defines the scope boundary and prioritized backlog
parsed.inputs: Intent statement, feasibility assessment, constraint register
parsed.outputs: scope-document.md, intent-backlog.md, scope-definition-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

parsed.condition: Execute when team composition, capacity, or mob planning is relevant. Skip for solo developer or small team projects.

parsed.outputs: team-assessment.md, skill-matrix.md, mob-composition.md, team-formation-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

parsed.condition: Execute when the system has any formal contract to pin down — an inter-unit boundary (more than one unit that must integrate) OR a unit that exposes a public/external API consumed outside the system. Skip only for a single self-contained unit with no inter-unit boundaries and no externally consumed API.
parsed.outputs: contract-summary.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved) — a human-readable overview of every contract (inter-unit boundaries and public/external APIs), each with a fenced spec block (OpenAPI / AsyncAPI / shared schema) inline

parsed.condition: Always executes — capstone Inception stage, produces the detailed execution plan for Construction and Operation
parsed.inputs: All Inception artifacts (requirements, stories, mockups, architecture, units)
parsed.outputs: bolt-plan.md, team-allocation.md, risk-and-sequencing-rationale.md, external-dependency-map.md, delivery-planning-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

parsed.condition: Execute when new components or logical building blocks are needed. Skip when changes are modifications to existing components only.

parsed.condition: Always rerun for freshness. Brownfield discovers from evidence + reverse-engineering artifacts. Greenfield prompts user via structured questions using org.md defaults.

parsed.condition: Execute when user-facing UI exists and rough mockups were produced in Ideation; for APIs, refine interaction diagrams

parsed.condition: Always executes — depth scales with project complexity

parsed.condition: Always executes when in scope. Produces the dependency DAG that Stage 2.9 Delivery Planning consumes for Bolt sequencing. In the compiled scope grid, 2.7 (Units Generation) and 2.9 (Delivery Planning) travel together — both EXECUTE or both SKIP per scope.

parsed.condition: Execute when user-facing features, multiple personas, complex business logic, or cross-team work is involved. Skip for pure refactoring, isolated bug fixes, infrastructure-only changes, or developer tooling.
